channel.title: ToolDune
channel.description: Free online tools: countdown timers, calculators, unit converters, text tools and generators.

item.title: Hiking Time Calculator — Naismith's Rule with Breaks
item.description: How long does that hike take? Distance, ascent and pace give walking time by Naismith's rule, plus break allowance and the turnaround point. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Backpack Weight Calculator — Total Load and the 20% Rule
item.description: Weigh your backpack before your shoulders do: base gear, food and water by trip days, total load and the 20% of body weight verdict. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Tent Size Calculator — What Rated Capacity to Actually Buy
item.description: What size tent for your group? Sleepers plus the +1 rule, with floor dimensions, packed weight and shoulder room - backpacking vs family. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Coast FIRE Calculator — Invested Today, Retired by Compounding
item.description: How much invested today means retirement at your target age with zero further saving? Coast FIRE number, surplus or deficit, and the return sensitivity. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Savings Rate Calculator — Years of Work Left at Your Rate
item.description: Your savings rate decides when work becomes optional: rate from income and spending, then years to FI on the famous 5%-return table. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: FIRE Number Calculator — Your Financial Independence Target
item.description: Your FIRE number: annual spending divided by an honest withdrawal rate (3.25-4.5%), with the gap, coast years and passive income shown. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Insulation Payback Calculator — Years to Recover the Upgrade Cost
item.description: Which insulation upgrade pays back first? Draft-proofing, loft, walls or windows - annual saving, payback years, 10-year net and CO₂. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Radiator Size Calculator — Watts and BTU by Room Volume
item.description: What size radiator does the room need? Area, ceiling height, insulation and window extras give watts, BTU/h and the physical length to look for. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Heating Cost Calculator — Season Cost by Area, Insulation and System
item.description: What will this winter cost? Home area, insulation and heating system give the season bill, monthly figure and the 1 °C setback saving. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Moving Timeline Planner — Week-by-Week Plan from Your Moving Date
item.description: Enter your moving date and get the week-by-week plan: when to book movers, declutter, change addresses and pack - with this week's task highlighted. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Moving Boxes Calculator — How Many Boxes by Bedrooms
item.description: How many moving boxes do you need? Bedrooms and packing style give the box count, size mix, tape and bubble wrap - plus the packing pace. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Moving Cost Calculator — Professional vs DIY, Honestly
item.description: What should your move cost? Professional crew vs DIY van with fuel, pizza wages and boxes - with the access traps that inflate quotes. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Laundry Detergent Calculator — The Right Dose per Wash
item.description: How much detergent per wash? Load size, soil level and water hardness give the right liquid or powder dose - and why overdosing makes clothes worse. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Fish Tank Stocking Calculator — How Many Fish Your Tank Supports
item.description: How many fish for your tank? Litres and adult fish size with community, cichlid and goldfish stocking rules, plus the nitrogen-cycle reality. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: TV Size Calculator — Right Screen Size for Your Sofa Distance
item.description: What size TV for your room? Sofa distance and resolution give the right diagonal in inches, with screen width and the too-close limit. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: E-Bike Charging Cost Calculator — Cents per Charge and per 100 km
item.description: What an e-bike really costs to run: charge cost from battery Wh and your electricity price, per 100 km and per year, with charger losses counted. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Bike Saddle Height Calculator — by Inseam and Riding Type
item.description: Correct saddle height from your inseam: LeMond factor for road, comfort and MTB variants, plus the knee-pain diagnostics. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: E-Bike Range Calculator — Real km from Your Battery
item.description: Real e-bike range, not brochure range: battery Wh divided by honest Wh/km for your assist level, with cold-weather and battery-health reality. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Carpool Savings Calculator — What Sharing the Ride Saves You
item.description: What carpooling actually saves: shared driving cost per person per year, CO₂ taken off the road, and the schedule rules that keep a pool alive. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Mileage Reimbursement Calculator — Total Owed for Your Trips
item.description: Total mileage reimbursement: distance times rate, in miles or km, with the gap versus your true cost per km and fuel-only warning. Free, no sign-up.
